regime_context: Detector reads a narrowing but not one-narrative regime: 22 of 49 themes are trend-eligible, with AI Infrastructure leading on rank but at only 0.5 durability (vs an elevated 0.5 bar) and mixed Hurst. Energy complex is the main challenger with better durability/breadth; crowding is low broadly except a few crowded themes (Cybersecurity, Managed Care, equal-weight Health Care). Momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), while the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure (leader, but thin durability 0.5 and breadth 0.125) hands off confirmed leadership to US Energy Complex (durability 0.62, breadth 0.636). I will only treat the handoff as confirmed if the energy complex opens a decisive, sustained gap over AI Infra on a relative-strength basis across at least two consecutive weeks — an early fade of AI Infra on this thin durability is explicitly not called here.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Second-ranked and eligible, but the more durable, broader trend relative to the leader: durability_bar 0.62 with breadth 0.636 and trend-tagged Hurst, versus leader AI Infra at durability 0.5 and breadth 0.125. The gate_helps=true state means trend-eligibility has historically trimmed drawdown on this market, and the energy leg is the highest-ranked theme whose trend health is not thin. This is a continuation lean on a stable trend, not a momentum-chase: the momentum rank is informational only.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control)
theses.dissent: Energy is a late-cycle, reflexive sector: crude-linked complex can roll over fast on a recession scare, and the high breadth (0.636) could mean it is fully extended before a mean-reversion in commodity prices.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 8% over the next 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 3 but crowded=true (crowding_z 1.61), the most extended crowding read on the board. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, not a short — so the disciplined expression of discomfort is to avoid adding fresh trend exposure here rather than fade it. The theme is not scorable as a distinct long vs the broad tech complex, and the extreme crowding flag argues against treating it as a clean trend entry.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a sizing caution, never a sell or short
theses.dissent: Crowding flags have no basket-level forward edge, and a persistent, broad (breadth 0.6) security-spending trend could keep grinding higher; avoidance may simply miss continued upside.

falsifier.text: CIBR falls back below its 20-day average and stays there for 10+ sessions, showing the trend is actually intact rather than broken.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
